fusions.name: Ankle Snag
fusions.desc: A low hooking sweep at an enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Long Road Reaping
fusions.desc: Sweeps the haft around at knee height, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, ignoring armour. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have walked since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Braced Stance
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 3 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Miles in the Arm
fusions.desc: After you cover a stretch of ground, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
